# actionlint known-issues ratchet — files with GENUINE findings, not yet fixed.
#
# ── REDEFINED 2026-08-19 (WR #17734) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# This file used to hold 150 workflows excluded because the old 2022 linter
# (rethab/actions-lint@v1.0.0) false-positived on modern syntax it could not
# parse. That linter has been replaced by actionlint, which understands the
# `||` fallback operator, `secrets.*` outside workflow_call, and choice-typed
# inputs — so 138 of those 150 files lint clean and are now actually covered.
#
# What remains below is the opposite of the old list: these are the ONLY files
# where actionlint reports a REAL defect. They are excluded so the gate can be
# green and stay meaningful, and each one is a bug to fix, not a quirk to
# tolerate. Findings are tracked in WR #17742.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. tests/actions-lint-workflow.test.js pins its
# length; adding an entry fails the suite. Fix the workflow instead — that is
# the point of a ratchet. Never add a NEW workflow file here.
#
# Current findings (actionlint 1.7.7, `-shellcheck= -pyflakes=`):
#   agent-fallback.yml         step output `cursor_available` not defined
#   auto-error-handler.yml     step output `issue_url` not defined
#   auto-reset-stuck-issues.yml  stray top-level `description:` key
#   bito-ai.yml                needs `pr-context` not defined
#   budget-aware-agent.yml     needs `routing` / `assess-budget` not defined
#   dprint-check.yml           `runner` context used where unavailable
#   news-with-cache.yml        step output `date` not defined
#   pr-review-status.yml       needs `determine-review-state` not defined
#   release-banner-social.yml  `secrets` context used where unavailable
#   reset-self-heal-issue.yml  stray top-level `description:` key
#   security-fleet.yml         array evaluated inside ${{ }}
#   wr-pr-creation.yml         input `issue_number` not defined (see #17736)
#
